item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Here's your weather for Monday, September 14. A fresh new week begins today. Here in Shanghai, the day will be sunny in between the clouds. The high will be 30 degrees, and the low will be 23 degrees. It's going to be a real scorcher. The chance of rain is 10 percent. The sun goes down at 6:01 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? It's a hot one. A sun hat and a water bottle are a good idea! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be part sun and part cloud, reaching 29 degrees. This week our theme is school bags and desks. Notice how you like to keep yours. That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
